If the equation is graphed in the \x3Cspan>xy\x3C/span>-plane, which of the following is the best interpretation of the \x3Cspan>x\x3C/span>-coordinate of the line&rsquo;s \x3Cspan>x\x3C/span>-intercept in the context of the problem?\x3C/p>",rationale:"\x3Cp>Choice C is correct.
